name: Rio LED
summary: Juwel's classic rectangular tank, sold with the filter, heater and lighting already fitted. Every size comes with a Bioflow internal filter tucked into a rear corner, an AquaHeat heater inside that filter and a MultiLux LED unit in the lid. It is a framed, lidded tank, so it suits community planted tanks more than open, rimless aquascapes.
highlights: Six sizes from 125 to 450 litres, all with filter, heater and light included
Bioflow internal filter sits in the back corner, so there are no hoses or canister to house
MultiLux LED lid with two replaceable tubes; HeliaLux Spectrum is a direct upgrade
Matching cabinet available for every size in black, white, grey or light wood
bestFor: Keepers who want a complete, matched setup in one box and are happy with a lidded, framed look.
watchOut: The stock two-tube MultiLux suits easy plants; a demanding carpet in the deeper sizes will want a stronger light and CO2.

specs.Included: Bioflow internal filter, AquaHeat heater, MultiLux LED lighting
specs.Cabinet: Optional matching cabinet (73 cm tall for 125/180/240, 80 cm for 290/350/450)

name: Lido LED
summary: A taller, deeper take on the Rio, with a near-cube footprint that gives you more front-to-back room for layering plants and hardscape. Like the rest of the Juwel range it arrives with a Bioflow internal filter, AquaHeat heater and MultiLux LED lid. The extra height looks great but makes light reach the substrate a bit harder.
highlights: Two sizes, 120 and 200 litres, with a deep, tall footprint
Bioflow M internal filter and AquaHeat heater fitted in the rear corner
MultiLux LED lighting in the lid, upgradeable to HeliaLux Spectrum
Optional matching cabinet in black, white, grey or light wood
bestFor: Anyone with limited wall length who still wants depth for a layered scape or taller stem plants.
watchOut: At 58 to 65 cm tall, the stock light struggles to grow demanding foreground plants at the bottom.

specs.Included: Bioflow M internal filter, AquaHeat heater, MultiLux LED lighting
specs.Cabinet: Optional matching cabinet (73 cm tall for 120, 80 cm for 200)

name: Vision LED
summary: Juwel's bow-front tank, where a curved front pane gives the scape a wider, more immersive look from the sofa. It comes as a set with a matching cabinet, plus the usual Bioflow internal filter, AquaHeat heater and MultiLux LED lighting. The curve adds drama but also some distortion when you view from an angle.
highlights: Curved front glass for a panoramic view of the layout
Three sizes: 180, 260 and 450 litres
Supplied with matching cabinet, Bioflow filter, heater and MultiLux LED
Deeper 46 to 61 cm footprint on the larger models leaves room for layering
bestFor: Living-room display tanks where the tank is a feature piece and you like the bow-front look.
watchOut: Curved glass bends the view at the edges, which some aquascapers find distracting for photos.

specs.Included: Matching cabinet (73 cm tall), Bioflow internal filter, AquaHeat heater, MultiLux LED lighting

name: Trigon LED
summary: A corner aquarium with a curved front, designed to tuck into the corner of a room and still show off a lot of water. It ships with a matching corner cabinet, a Bioflow internal filter, AquaHeat heater and MultiLux LED lighting. The triangular footprint gives real depth, but it is an awkward shape for a classic aquascape layout.
highlights: Corner shape makes use of space most tanks cannot
Two sizes: 190 and 350 litres
Supplied with matching corner cabinet, Bioflow filter, heater and MultiLux LED
Depth of 70 to 87 cm gives a strong sense of perspective
bestFor: Rooms where a corner is the only spot for a sizeable tank and you want a complete, matched set.
watchOut: Deep water and a wide triangular lid make even lighting and reaching the back for planting and trimming harder.

specs.Included: Matching corner cabinet (73 cm tall), Bioflow internal filter, AquaHeat heater, MultiLux LED lighting

extra.Lighting: MultiLux LED (12 W and 23 W tubes)

name: Primo LED
summary: Juwel's entry-level 60 cm tank, with a lid, LED light, small internal filter and heater all included. It sits on a built-in safety base frame, so it goes straight onto a sturdy surface without a mat. A sensible first planted tank for easy species, though the single small LED limits what you can grow.
highlights: Two heights on the same 61 x 31 cm footprint: 57 and 70 litres
Bioflow One internal filter with 300 L/h pump and AquaHeat 50 W heater hidden in the filter
NovoLux LED 60 light (8 W); the lid takes up to three units
Feeding hatch in the lid fits Juwel automatic feeders
bestFor: Beginners wanting a complete 60 cm tank for low-light plants, shrimp or a small community.
watchOut: One 8 W NovoLux is only enough for undemanding plants such as Anubias, ferns and Cryptocoryne.

specs.Included: Bioflow One filter with Eccoflow 300 pump (4.4 W), AquaHeat 50 W heater, NovoLux LED 60 (8 W)

name: Vio Cube
summary: A compact 54 litre cube from Juwel that comes ready to run with filter, heater and LED lighting. The cube shape suits an iwagumi or a small jungle scape viewed from the front, and it fits on a desk or sideboard. A matching SBX cabinet is sold separately if you want it at viewing height.
highlights: 54 litres in a 41 x 36 x 47 cm cube with 5 mm glass
Bioflow S filter with a 300 L/h Eccoflow pump and AquaHeat 50 W heater included
NovoLux LED 40 Neo lighting in the cover, with a feeding opening
Built-in base frame, so no separate mat is needed
bestFor: Small-space keepers wanting a tidy, complete nano setup for shrimp, small fish and easy plants.
watchOut: The lidded design and small included light suit low-tech planting rather than a high-light CO2 scape.

specs.Included: Bioflow S filter with Eccoflow 300 pump (4.4 W), AquaHeat 50 W heater, NovoLux LED 40 Neo
specs.Cabinet: Optional Vio Cube SBX cabinet (73 cm tall)

name: HighLine Optiwhite
summary: Oase's large furniture-style aquarium sets, pairing a low-iron Optiwhite tank with a flush, handle-free cabinet. Unlike the Juwel sets, lighting and filtration are not included: you choose your own lights and an external filter, which sits on a pull-out shelf inside the cabinet. That makes it a good blank canvas for a serious planted tank, at a serious price.
highlights: Optiwhite glass for a clear view without the green tint
Four sizes from 202 to 580 litres, 10 to 12 mm glass
Pull-out cabinet shelf and dry duct for an external filter and tidy cables
Removable aluminium lid with feeding flap; lighting chosen separately
bestFor: Keepers planning a large, long-term display who want to pick their own canister filter and lights.
watchOut: The price covers only tank and cabinet; budget separately for lights, filter and heater.

specs.Included: Aquarium, base cabinet and connections; no light, filter or heater
specs.Lighting: Sold separately (Oase Classic LED or Premium LED)
specs.Cabinet: Push-to-open doors, adjustable feet, pull-out filter shelf, optional drawers

name: ScaperLine
summary: A rimless, mitre-cut Optiwhite tank built for aquascaping, sold as a set with a flush matching cabinet. The cabinet is laid out for a scaper, with a pull-out shelf for an external filter, magnetic tool holders and a hidden cable port. No light or filter is included, so you build the tech around it yourself.
highlights: Rimless Optiwhite glass with hand-glued mitred edges
Three sizes: 75, 180 and 250 litres
Cabinet has a pull-out filter shelf, magnetic tool and towel holders
Handle-free, push-to-open doors keep the lines clean
bestFor: Aquascapers who want an open-top, show-quality tank and cabinet that match, and already know which light and filter they want.
watchOut: Open-top tanks lose more water to evaporation and need a light that hangs or mounts on the rim.

specs.Included: Aquarium and matching cabinet; no light, filter or heater
specs.Colours: Black or grey (white cabinet also offered)
specs.Cabinet: Also sold on its own (see ScaperLine Cabinet)

name: StyleLine
summary: Oase's complete starter sets: tank, cabinet, BioPlus Thermo internal filter with built-in heater, and a pair of Classic LED daylight tubes. A removable glass sliding cover and aluminium trim along the bottom hide the waterline and substrate edge. It is a tidy, modern-looking all-in-one for someone who does not want to piece a system together.
highlights: Three sizes: 75, 115 and 160 litres
BioPlus Thermo corner filter with integrated heater included
Two Classic LED daylight (6,500 K) tubes supplied
Push-to-open cabinet with internal shelf
bestFor: Beginners after a complete, good-looking tank and cabinet set for a low-tech planted community tank.
watchOut: The two daylight tubes are enough for easy plants, but a high-light setup would need a lighting upgrade.

specs.Included: Aquarium, cabinet, BioPlus Thermo internal filter, 2 x Classic LED daylight

name: Vio Cube SBX Cabinet
summary: The matching cabinet for the Juwel Vio Cube 54. It matches the tank's 41 x 36 cm footprint exactly and lifts it to a comfortable viewing height, with a shelf inside for food and spares.
highlights: Made for the Vio Cube 54 footprint
41 x 36 x 73 cm
Door and internal shelf for storage
Black or white to match the tank
bestFor: Vio Cube owners who want the tank freestanding at eye level rather than on existing furniture.

name: ScaperLine Cabinet
summary: The base cabinet from the ScaperLine set, sold on its own. It sits flush with the ScaperLine 100 tank and has the scaper-friendly details: a pull-out shelf for an external filter, a magnetic tool holder, towel holder and a sealable cable channel.
highlights: Sized to sit flush under the ScaperLine 100 aquarium
Pull-out shelf for an external filter
Magnetic holder for scissors and tweezers, plus a towel rail
Optional back panel turns it into a room divider
bestFor: Anyone buying a ScaperLine 100 tank separately, or replacing the cabinet.
watchOut: It is made for the ScaperLine 100 footprint, so check dimensions before using it with another tank.

name: HeliaLux Spectrum
summary: Juwel's step-up LED bar, with white LEDs at 9,000 K and 6,500 K plus red, green and blue channels. It drops into any Juwel tank with a fixed top frame, and a UniversalFit holder lets it sit on other tanks too. Compared with the stock MultiLux it adds colour channels and, with the SmartControl or AppControl added, dimming and scheduling.
highlights: Eight lengths from 55 to 150 cm to match Juwel tanks
White plus RGB LEDs for plant growth and better colour rendering
About 140 lumens per watt, with aluminium honeycomb heat sinks
Scratch-resistant safety glass over the LEDs
bestFor: Juwel tank owners who want to grow a wider range of plants than the stock MultiLux allows.
watchOut: Dimming, sunrise and colour control need the HeliaLux SmartControl or AppControl, sold separately.

specs.LEDs: White 9,000 K and 6,500 K plus red, green and blue
specs.Mounting: Juwel tanks with fixed top frame; UniversalFit holder for other tanks

name: MultiLux LED
summary: The standard light unit fitted to Juwel's LED aquariums, holding two replaceable glass LED tubes (one DAY, one NATURE). It is sealed against moisture and lets you work in the tank with the light on. Buying one on its own makes sense for replacing a T5 unit or a broken lid light.
highlights: Eight lengths from 55 to 150 cm to fit Juwel tanks
Two replaceable LED tubes, 9,000 K and 6,500 K
Moisture-blocking membrane keeps the unit dry
Roughly half the energy of the old T5 units
bestFor: Juwel owners converting from T5 or replacing a lid light for a low-light planted or community tank.
watchOut: There is no dimming or scheduling built in, so plan on a plug-in timer, or look at the HeliaLux Spectrum if you want control.

specs.Tubes: 2 x replaceable Juwel LED tubes (DAY and NATURE fitted)

name: HighLine Classic LED
summary: A slim, fully waterproof LED tube in a 6,500 K daylight tone, made as the lighting for Oase HighLine aquariums. Each tube has its own on/off switch and is IP68 rated, and it fits other tanks with compatible holders. HighLine tanks are usually lit with two of these side by side.
highlights: Five lengths from 40 to 120 cm
900 to 2,950 lumens per tube
IP68 waterproof with inline toggle switch
Daylight spectrum suited to plants and natural colours
bestFor: HighLine owners, or anyone wanting simple, waterproof daylight tubes for a low to medium-light tank.
watchOut: No dimming or scheduling on its own; you will want a plug-in timer.

name: MotionControl LED
summary: Oase's controllable LED bar with four channels: neutral white, cool white, royal blue and red. Through the Oase aquarium controller and app you can set colour and intensity by segment and run sunrise and sunset effects. It is freshwater only and IP68 sealed, with a thin 15 mm profile.
highlights: Five lengths from 44 to 133 cm
Neutral white, cool white, royal blue and red LEDs
Segment-by-segment colour and brightness control via app
IP68 waterproof, no condensation inside the housing
bestFor: Keepers with an Oase HighLine or ScaperLine who want app-controlled, adjustable-spectrum lighting.
watchOut: It needs the Oase aquarium controller and 120 W Control transformer, both sold separately, so the real cost is higher than the bar alone.

specs.Channels: Neutral white, cool white, royal blue, red
specs.Control: Oase aquarium controller and app (sold separately); IR control set optional
specs.Power supply: Oase Control Aquarium Transformer 120 W (sold separately)

name: BioMaster 2
summary: Oase's main canister filter, built around a pre-filter module you lift out and rinse without opening the whole canister. Water passes through foam first, so the Hel-X biological media behind it stays clean for much longer. A heater can be retrofitted later, and there is a Thermo version with one already fitted.
highlights: Five sizes for tanks from 150 to 850 litres
Pre-filter lifts out for a quick rinse without opening the canister
3 to 8 litres of media including Hel-X
Priming button and auto shut-off valves make restarts easy
bestFor: Medium to large planted tanks where you want long gaps between full cleans and easy weekly pre-filter rinses.
watchOut: Rated flow drops once hoses, lily pipes and media are fitted, so size up for a heavily planted tank.

specs.Pre-filter: EasyClean removable pre-filter module, 30/45 ppi sponges
specs.Safety: Automatic shut-off valve when the pre-filter is removed
specs.Thermo versions: Available with a built-in heater (models marked Thermo), which keeps the heater out of the tank

name: FiltoSmart
summary: A compact, budget-friendly canister from Oase for small and mid-sized tanks. It has a self-venting start, shut-off valves on the connectors and an EasyClick lid, and it comes complete with media, hoses and pipes. The smallest model is a genuinely tiny canister that suits nano tanks.
highlights: Four sizes for tanks from 60 to 300 litres
FiltoSmart 60 is small enough for a nano cabinet or beside the tank
Self-venting start-up and shut-off valves for spill-free cleaning
Flow adjustable at the inlet and outlet adapters
bestFor: Nano to mid-sized planted tanks where you want a quiet canister without paying BioMaster money.
watchOut: Media volume is modest on the 60 and 100, so they need cleaning more often than bigger canisters.

specs.Supplied with: Media, hoses, adapters, intake and outflow pipes, spray diffuser
specs.Thermo versions: Available with a built-in heater (models marked Thermo), which keeps the heater out of the tank

name: BioStyle
summary: A hang-on-back filter from Oase that hooks over the rim, so there are no hoses and nothing takes up space inside the tank. It uses a drop-in cartridge with foam, fleece and carbon, and a telescopic clear intake adjusts to your tank depth. Flow is generous for the size, which suits small tanks with light fish loads.
highlights: Three sizes for tanks up to 70, 115 or 180 litres
350 to 900 L/h from 3.5 to 4.5 W
Cartridge change indicator and simple swap-out media
Adjustable spacers for a secure fit on the rim
bestFor: Small planted tanks or shrimp tanks where you want easy filtration without a canister or an internal box.
watchOut: Hang-on filters splash at the surface, which drives off some CO2 in an injected tank.

specs.Mounting: Hangs on the tank rim, adjustable spacers

name: BioCompact
summary: A very small internal filter for nano and quarantine tanks. It can be mounted upright or on its side, which makes it handy in shallow water, and the flow is adjustable at the outlet. The 50 has a media chamber you can refill with whatever you like.
highlights: Two sizes for tanks up to 25 or 50 litres
Adjustable flow of roughly 120 to 240 L/h
Can be installed horizontally for shallow water
5 W pump
bestFor: Nano tanks, shrimp tanks and quarantine tanks where space is tight.
watchOut: Tiny media capacity means frequent rinsing, and it is visible in the tank.

name: BioPlus
summary: A corner internal filter with a built-in, adjustable outlet nozzle instead of a separate spray bar. The media unit unclips and lifts out while the pump stays put, which makes cleaning quick. Foam plus a fine fleece stage gives decent polishing for its size.
highlights: Three sizes for tanks up to 50, 100 or 200 litres
350 to 650 L/h from 5 to 7 W
Media unit lifts out for cleaning, pump stays in place
Fits neatly in a rear corner with suction cups
bestFor: Small to mid-sized tanks where you want a simple internal filter that is easy to service.
watchOut: It sits inside the tank, so it takes up scaping space and needs hiding behind plants or hardscape.

specs.Thermo versions: Available with a built-in heater (models marked Thermo), which keeps the heater out of the tank

name: Bioflow
summary: The large internal box filter built into Juwel aquariums, also sold on its own. Water runs down through stacked sponges and media baskets, with space for a Juwel heater inside the housing and an Eccoflow pump on top. There are no hoses, so nothing can leak outside the tank.
highlights: Three sizes: M (3.5 L media), L (8 L), XL (11 L)
600 or 1,000 L/h Eccoflow pump using 7 to 8 W
Room for a Juwel AquaHeat heater inside the filter
Five media stages supplied: poly pad, carbon, Nitrax, coarse and fine sponges
bestFor: Juwel owners replacing or upgrading a filter, or anyone happy with a big internal box in exchange for no hoses.
watchOut: It takes up a noticeable slice of the back corner and needs a tank at least 42.5 cm (M) or 60 cm (L, XL) tall.

name: HeatUp
summary: An adjustable glass heater with a bimetal thermostat, available from 25 W to 400 W. It is the same heater Oase builds into its Thermo filters, and it can be fitted into a FiltoSmart or BioMaster later, or used in the tank with the supplied holder. A plain, dependable choice if you just want a heater that holds temperature.
highlights: Nine wattages from 25 to 400 W
Bimetal thermostat with adjustable setting
Retrofits into FiltoSmart and BioMaster filters
Mounting holder included for in-tank use
bestFor: Oase filter owners who want to add heating later, or anyone after a simple adjustable heater.
watchOut: A 25 to 50 W unit is still 20 cm long, so check it fits a shallow nano.

name: AquaHeat
summary: Juwel's adjustable glass heaters, made in borosilicate glass with TÜV/GS safety certification. They are shaped to sit inside the Bioflow filter housing in Juwel aquariums, where they stay out of sight and heat the water as it passes through. They work in any tank, but they make most sense in a Juwel.
highlights: 50 W AquaHeat and 100, 200, 300 W AquaHeat Pro
Adjustable thermostat, borosilicate glass
Fits inside Juwel Bioflow filter housings
TÜV/GS certified
bestFor: Juwel aquarium owners replacing or upgrading the heater inside their Bioflow filter.

specs.Fits: Juwel Bioflow filter housings, or any tank

name: OptiMax
summary: A range of adjustable water pumps from 300 to 5,000 L/h, for circulation, running a DIY filter or returning water from a sump. The smaller models are submersible only, while the 800 and up can also run dry outside the tank. Flow is adjustable on every model.
highlights: Eight sizes from 300 to 5,000 L/h
Adjustable flow on all models
800 and larger can be installed dry (inline) or submerged
Suction feet for secure placement
bestFor: Sump returns, DIY filters, water changes or extra circulation in a larger planted tank.
watchOut: The 2000 and up draw 30 to 80 W, which adds up on your bill and adds heat to the water if submerged.

name: OxyMax
summary: Small mains air pumps from Oase with adjustable output, supplied with airline and air stones. They can stand or hang, and run quietly on 3.5 to 4 W. Handy for overnight aeration in a CO2 tank, sponge filters or a hospital tank.
highlights: Three sizes: 100, 200 or 360 L/h
One or two outlets, adjustable output
3.5 to 4 W power draw
Hose and air stones included
bestFor: Running sponge filters or night-time aeration in small to mid-sized planted tanks.

name: ClearTronic
summary: An inline UV-C clarifier that plumbs into your filter outlet hose and clears green water and free-floating bacteria. The ballast is built into the body, so there is no separate box to find room for in the cabinet. The lamp and quartz sleeve come out with a quick-release for cleaning.
highlights: 7, 9 or 11 W UV-C for tanks up to 250, 400 or 600 litres
Integrated ballast, compact 33 cm body
Quick-release for lamp changes and quartz cleaning
Connection accessories included
bestFor: Canister-filtered tanks prone to green water, or keepers who want an extra safeguard against outbreaks.
watchOut: UV lamps lose strength over time and need replacing roughly yearly, and UV does not fix the nutrient or light imbalance behind algae.

name: EccoSkim
summary: A powered surface skimmer that pulls the oily film off the water surface. It clips straight onto a Juwel internal filter, sending the skimmed water into it, or mounts with suction cups in other glass tanks. A float keeps the inlet at the waterline as levels drop.
highlights: 300 L/h at 4.4 W, adjustable
Clips onto Juwel Bioflow filters or mounts with suction cups
Floating inlet follows the water level
Clears surface film that blocks light and gas exchange
bestFor: Planted tanks, especially CO2 injected ones, that build up surface film.
watchOut: It sits inside the tank, so it adds another bit of kit to hide.

specs.Mounting: Juwel filter mount or suction holder

name: Plant Scissors
summary: A 25 cm pair of aquarium scissors with a curved tip for trimming stem plants and carpets. The length reaches the back of a typical 45 to 50 cm deep tank without soaking your sleeve.
highlights: 25 cm long
Curved tip for trimming carpets and low plants
Freshwater use
bestFor: Regular trimming of stems and carpeting plants in small to mid-sized tanks.

name: AquaClean 2.0
summary: A siphon gravel cleaner that starts with a squeeze of the bulb, so there is no sucking on a hose. Extension tubes suit tanks up to 70 cm tall, and a special nozzle reaches into the corners of a Juwel internal filter.
highlights: Squeeze-bulb start
Modular tube for tanks up to 70 cm tall
Attachment for cleaning Juwel internal filters
Clips to hold the hose on the bucket and tank
bestFor: Weekly water changes and cleaning gravel or sand in open areas of a planted tank.
watchOut: Keep it off aqua soil, as it will pull up the soil granules.

name: FishGuard
summary: A programmable auto feeder with an LCD display, set up for up to four feeds a day and up to three portions per feed. The food drum is sealed against moisture, which matters over a humid tank.
highlights: Up to 4 feeds a day, up to 3 portions each
Clear LCD programming
Moisture-protected food drum
Works over freshwater, saltwater or terrariums
bestFor: Holidays or busy weeks with a community tank that needs regular small feeds.
watchOut: Test the portion size for a few days first; overfeeding while you are away is the usual problem.

specs.Feeds: Up to 4 per day, up to 3 portions per feed

name: SmartFeed 2.0
summary: Juwel's more capable auto feeder, using a screw feed to dispense granules or flakes in eight portion sizes. It runs on batteries or micro USB, has a large display, and the 110 ml chamber can be doubled with the supplied extension.
highlights: Up to 3 feeds a day, 8 portion levels
Two feed screws for granules and flakes
110 ml chamber plus 110 ml extension included
Battery (4 x AA supplied) or micro USB power
bestFor: Longer holidays or keepers who want precise portions of flake or granules.

specs.Feeds: Up to 3 per day, intervals of 24/48/72 h

name: Easy Feed
summary: A simple battery auto feeder that fits Juwel lids directly and other tanks with a mount. It feeds once or twice a day and the adjustable drum holds about 60 portions, best with pellets.
highlights: 1 or 2 feeds a day
Adjustable drum holds up to 60 feeds
Drum can be ventilated with an air pump in humid setups
Batteries included
bestFor: Budget holiday feeding for a Juwel tank with pellet-eating fish.
watchOut: Flake does not dispense as reliably as pellets from a drum feeder.
